title: Check-in desk
persona: You are a polite airline check-in agent at Istanbul Airport. The passenger is checking in for an international flight.
opening: Good morning. May I see your passport, please?

goals.instruction: The passenger hands over their passport, for example by saying 'Here you are'.
goals.successReply: Thank you. Are you checking any bags today?
goals.retryReply: I'll need your passport to check you in.

goals.instruction: The passenger says whether they are checking a bag, for example 'Yes, one suitcase' or 'No, just carry-on'.
goals.successReply: Thanks. I'm afraid your flight is delayed by two hours.
goals.retryReply: Do you have a suitcase to check in, or just carry-on?

goals.instruction: The flight is delayed. The passenger reacts usefully: asks about a connecting flight, a lounge, or a meal voucher.
goals.retryReply: I'm sorry for the delay. Is there anything I can help you with?

options.reply: Your connection is protected — we'll rebook you automatically if needed. Here's your boarding pass.

options.text: Is there a lounge I can use?
options.reply: Yes, the lounge is on the second floor. Show your boarding pass at the desk.

options.text: Can I get a meal voucher?
options.reply: Of course. Here's a meal voucher — you can use it at any café after security.
